name: VnExpress Marathon Nha Trang
short_description: VnExpress Marathon Nha Trang is a Full/Half/10K/5K coastal marathon in Nha Trang, Vietnam, confirmed for 9 August 2026.
ai_summary: VnExpress Marathon Nha Trang 2026 is a coastal marathon in Nha Trang, Khanh Hoa, organized by VnExpress and FPT Online, confirmed for 9 August 2026. It offers Full Marathon, Half Marathon, 10km, and 5km distances, all starting and finishing at 2-4 Square on Tran Phu. Late-phase entry, which ran from 28 July to 2 August 2026, cost 850,000 VND for the 5km and 1,550,000 VND for the Full Marathon.
pros: Big, well-supplied race: 23 aid stations on the marathon, 18 with medical points, plus pacers from 3:30 to 4:30
Seafront 5 km and 10 km on Tran Phu that avoid the pass, suited to first-timers and families
Course certified by World Athletics and AIMS, with a single start and finish at 2-4 Square
Shallow field behind the winners: tenth place in the 2026 marathon was 3:01:33 for men and 3:32:32 for women
cons: Hot even at night: 30°C at the 3am start in 2026, and never below 29°C during the race
Repeated climbs over Luong Son Pass between about km 24 and km 35 of the marathon
Marathon checkpoints demand about 9:00 per km from the gun, before the pass
No refunds or bib transfers, and race kits must be collected in person or by someone you authorise

research_highlights: Course runs along Nha Trang's iconic Tran Phu and Pham Van Dong coastal roads with sunrise starts (full marathon typically starts around 3am), plus a climb over Luong Son Pass (roughly up to 60m elevation) that is the main challenge for the 21km and 42km distances.

For 2026 all distances started and finished at 2-4 Square; the 21km climbed Luong Son Pass from about km 9.5 (the pass was not in the 2025 21km), and the 42km reached the pass at about km 24.5 after inner-city roads by the Quan Truong river.
The event has grown steadily — from about 8,500 runners at its 2022 debut to roughly 13,000 in 2025 — and is run as a multi-day 'race-cation' weekend with an expo, race-kit pickup and side events.

Race-day weather is described as generally hot for Vietnam summer (organizers and past coverage cite temperatures commonly in the high-20s to low-30s °C around race time, though some editions reported cooler, even rainy conditions).
The 2026 marathon map shows 23 aid stations, 18 of them with medical points, with toilets placed beside the aid stations.
research_watchouts: Heat and humidity are a recurring theme — organizer and news coverage repeatedly warn that many runners lose pace or drop out around km 25-30 due to heat-related fatigue rather than lack of fitness.

The Luong Son Pass climb is consistently flagged by runners and elites as the toughest technical/physical section, requiring extra hydration/electrolyte planning and shoe choice with more cushioning and grip for the descent.
Course details change from year to year (route length on the pass, finish area, start location), so runners should check the current year's official map rather than assume it matches a prior edition.
BIBs are not sent in advance for the 2026 edition — runners must collect their bib number in person at race-kit pickup rather than receiving it by email beforehand.

faqs.question: Who organizes the VnExpress Marathon Nha Trang?
faqs.answer: The race is organised by VnExpress, a Vietnamese online newspaper, together with FPT Online. VnExpress also publishes much of the race coverage, including the route, prize and results reports. The 2026 edition, held on 9 August, was the fifth, and the organiser reported a field of 10,000 runners across four distances.

faqs.question: What distances does the VnExpress Marathon Nha Trang offer?
faqs.answer: Four distances are available: a Full Marathon, a Half Marathon, a 10km, and a 5km, all starting in the coastal city of Nha Trang. This spread lets everything from first-time 5km runners to full-marathon veterans take part in the same race weekend.
